title: WisdomInvocationInput
description: Source of truth: elohim-agent-service (Operational, Category C). Input payload for POST /wisdom/invoke. Not persisted; the service produces a WisdomInvocationResponse that may be used for DHT attestation in Phase 9+.

constitutionCid.description: CID of the constitution ContentNode that governs this wisdom invocation

framingCid.description: CID of the framing ContentNode that scopes the specific wisdom question

contextKeys.description: Which GateContext keys the wisdom call should consider

contextJson.description: Serialized subset of GateContext values for the declared contextKeys — pre-assembled by the gate executor

eventSummary.description: Short natural-language description of the relational impact event being judged
